vendors.name: Storekit
vendors.reason: Its own docs list Malta as supported (English, EUR payments), but no EUR plan price exists on its site: plans are shown in GBP only (round 1: Starter £0, Grow £99, Pro £199). Not counted: no EUR price.

vendors.name: Order Tiger
vendors.reason: EUR price exists ('€59 in the EU'), but nothing found showing it sells in Malta (search only; strict MT rule). Not opened.

vendors.name: Zaype (LogicPass Ltd)
vendors.reason: Maltese consumer takeaway/delivery marketplace app (restaurants listed on Zaype for a flat monthly fee, per a news article); a marketplace, not the business's own ordering tool. Found by search, not opened.

vendors.name: SumUp (online store)
vendors.reason: Malta is a SumUp country (footer country selector lists Malta at /en-mt/; '€0' monthly, '2.5 %' transaction fee), but it is the generic web shop with no food ordering, pickup or order-ahead wording on the page. Fallback only, not a real food tool; not counted.

plans.note: Generic web shop; 'Competitive transaction fee' 2.5 %. Recorded as fallback only.

vendors.name: Maltix
vendors.reason: Help-centre pages (search snippets) describe 'client QR order, pay and pick up' and mention 'UK £ Easy Pay'; both help-centre pages opened returned 404. No EUR price or Malta presence could be read from its own site.

notes: Strict rule (no neighbour). FoxiFood (d03a6e1f) stored and counted. After 5 vendors, nothing else eligible: no other tool whose own site shows it sells in Malta AND has an EUR price. Closest: Storekit (Malta listed as a supported region, but GBP prices only) and SumUp (Malta site, EUR, but a generic web shop, fallback only). Round-2 dead ends not repeated (H360 ORDER, Time To Eat Malta, Deliwee, KantinApp, ATS Malta). Search lead not followed: whoswho.mt says Maltese firm Sixteen partnered with Storekit (news article, not a source). Count stays 1.
